posts.name: seesome
posts.cooked:
The Kvothe as Argent Adept promo thread got me thinking about what alternate dimensions might exist in the Sentinels Multiverse.  Shattered Timelines touched on this classic comic book trope a bit with Iron Legacy, but that's really more of an alternate possible future than a full alternate reality (ditto for The Visionary's backstory).  Given that the game is called Sentinels of the Multiverse, we really need some true inter-dimensional versions of the characters.

So, here are some of the alternate universe versions of SotM characters that I'd want to see, starting with the F5:

Victorian steampunk Wraith

Sir Bunker of the Round Table

Absolute Zombie

The Council of Tachyons (perhaps they're the launching *point* for the dimensional *crisis*)

and, of course, no Multiverse would be complete without... the anthropomorphic rabbit version of Legacy

Bonus: We can't skip the dimension in which Baron Blade is the only hero in a world of villains.

 

P.S. I LOVE that the SotM universe is so well designed, that I'm already putting these stories together in my head and can totally picture what the comics would look like.

For Chrono-Ranger, I can't help but think of Roland and the Dark Tower (but that may be a bit too spot on with the character's inspiration)

Fanatic / Joan of Arc (Obvious, but that's the AU trope sometimes)

Ra / Instead of discovering the Staff of Ra, archaeologist Blake Washington uncovered the Necklace of the Aztec god, Quetzalcoatl

Haka / Calico Haka (Pirate Captain Calico Jack Rackham). Of course, given Haka's age, he might have been a pirate captain at one point.

Nightmist / Maltese Falcon-esque 1940s gumshoe story

Anthony "T.D." Drake of the boy band "Argent Adept and The Silver Shadows".

Chairman Montgomery, with her boyfriend The Operative, who grew cold, heartless, and hardened after a harrowing encounter on a date in their youth.

Riske, Agent of F.I.L.T.E.R., who offsets his bad luck with his combat training.  After Peter Riske infiltrated Baron Blade's lair as an undercover agent masquerading as a hapless casino worker, he was subjected to experimentation resulting in him generating bad luck.  After being further outfitted with some anti-entropy super tech by F.I.L.T.E.R., he became the Japing Yager Neutralizing Xenocracy.  His outfits always rip and his tech always breaks, but no one survives an encounter with J.Y.N.X.

Grand Warlord Dall'ton, who destroyed Voss and took control of his vast Gene-Bound army, enacting revenge against the galaxy despite the protests of the few remaining Maerynians.
